long_biography.plain_text:
The business began in 1964, when Helmut Dietz created a building-services company for industrial customers. After the founder's early death, Wolfgang Dietz entered in 1992. He used the post-reunification property market to widen the group from building technology and small housing projects into a broader construction and real estate platform.

The group later concentrated on larger commercial projects. Dietz shaped an integrated model covering project planning, development, letting, ownership, asset management and property services. Its mandates encompass logistics parks, industrial sites, offices and retail assets. Expansion beyond Germany included joint ventures in Dutch distribution hubs, while the Bensheim company retained a long-term ownership and active portfolio-management approach.
